name: Fathom
subtitle: Your listening, from your own repo
description: A native, read-only teal.fm dashboard for iOS. Fathom reads the plays already in your AT Protocol repository and computes the figures on your device.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: A read-only teal.fm dashboard
apps.localizedDescription:
Fathom is a native dashboard for the plays already in your AT Protocol repository.

Now — what is playing, today's plays and time, your current streak, a fourteen-day chart and recent plays.

Stats — plays, time, artists, releases and tracks for 7 days, 30 days or all time, with the busiest day and most used service.

History — every play, grouped by the day you actually had it, with search and a month jump.

Profile — your teal.fm profile, DID and a plain statement of where the figures come from.

Fathom is read-only. It has no account, no password and no token. It reads public records directly from your PDS, never through a Fathom backend, and saves the last read on your device so the next launch opens immediately.

AltStore Classic signs this unsigned IPA with your own Apple ID when it installs it.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fathom 0.2.1 fixes the F-Droid listing icon and moves both channels to build 10. There are no app behaviour changes.

## Fixed

- F-Droid now has a raster launcher icon at every density. 0.2.0's APK contained only the adaptive-icon XML, which fdroidserver does not render, so the listing had no icon.

## Install

- **iPhone and iPad:** add the AltStore Classic source at https://fathom-app-delta.vercel.app/altstore/source.json.
- **Android:** add the F-Droid repo at https://fathom-app-delta.vercel.app/fdroid/repo.

Direct APK and IPA downloads are attached to this release. There is no App Store or Google Play listing.

The apps have been run against a real account on an Android emulator and an iOS simulator, not on physical hardware. The Android APK is signed with the Fathom release key; the AltStore IPA is unsigned on purpose and is re-signed by AltStore Classic.

Fathom 0.2.0 is the first signed release, distributed through AltStore Classic and a self-hosted F-Droid repo.

## Install

- **iPhone and iPad:** add the AltStore Classic source at https://fathom-app-delta.vercel.app/altstore/source.json. AltStore Classic signs the unsigned IPA with your own Apple ID.
- **Android:** add the F-Droid repo at https://fathom-app-delta.vercel.app/fdroid/repo. The install link on the website includes the repo index fingerprint.
- Direct APK and IPA downloads are attached to this release.

There is no App Store or Google Play listing.

## What's changed

- Added History search over track, artist and release, implemented once in the shared Kotlin core.
- Added the History month jump and a match count that distinguishes no matches from no plays.
- Added About with the actual bundle version, the AGPL-3.0 text, third-party notices and legal links.
- Added the public website, privacy policy and terms.
- Added the unified release contract: local signing, one `v0.2.0` GitHub Release, and CI provenance for the exact published bytes.
- Added AltStore Classic and F-Droid channel files, with separate app-signing and repo-index keys.

## Verification and limitations

The apps have been run against a real account on an Android emulator and an iOS simulator. They have not been smoke-tested on physical hardware. The Android APK is signed with the Fathom release key. The AltStore IPA is unsigned on purpose; AltStore Classic re-signs it on install. The F-Droid repo index is signed with a separate, offline repo key.
